summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with 21 parametrized tests. The new tests pass (21 passed), and test/test_path.py still passes unchanged (42 passed together). No lines exceed 88 columns. mypy, ruff, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and import order were checked by reading the code only. Nothing is committed. Review points: a local object-typed alias keeps the None/str guard reachable under warn_unreachable; the pytest.raises type-ignore sits on the call line inside the block, not on the opening line, because the opening line makes no parser call.
